text: Local able-bodied youths gather here, drilling together in preparation for conscription.
Slashing and volley fire follow strict method, yet foes on the battlefield are no straw targets.
Veteran soldiers stand watch in rotation, drilling new recruits in preparation for fierce battle.
The Cathayan ranks stand in solemn, orderly formation, armor gleaming beneath the sun, poised and ready.
Cathay's heroes guard the Dragon Emperor, and defend the common people of the realm besides.
Only by sitting quietly amid forest and stream may one grasp the secrets of the wind.
The hall welcomes the worthy and seeks talent from across the realm.
The mysteries of the stars are stored within this tower, and the movements of the heavens observed from its platform.
Countless scholars toil day and night, seeking to unravel the mysteries of heaven and earth.
Atop the high tower stands the Pavilion of Heavenly Light; once activated, it may summon sentinels to watch over all under heaven.
Skilled artisans pass their trade down through hereditary households, preserving exquisite craft.
Fireworks bloom over an age of prosperity; iron and blood forge lasting peace.
The casting techniques of Nan Gao spread throughout the Celestial Empire; gunpowder and firearms stand ready against jackals.
Whether crafting precision components or field artillery, Cathayan engineers are masters of both.
The greatest war machines and deadliest shells alike emerge from this roar of thunder and smoke.
White-haired fishermen and woodcutters upon the riverside, sharing a jug of cloudy wine in idle talk.
Merchant vessels dock here in great number, making the seafood taverns especially prosperous.
The vast harbor shelters ships from storm and wave; reduced trade tariffs draw merchants from afar in droves.
A trade hub renowned throughout the world, receiving thousands of vessels daily and harboring naval fleets ever ready to set sail.
Though the vast rivers and seas stretch endlessly beyond sight, ringed by peninsulas and sandbars and dotted with islands and lighthouses, they have become, in truth, Cathay's own inland lake.
The Celestial Empire of Cathay reveres horsemanship; in idle hours, riders challenge one another astride their steeds.
Fine horses from every corner bring their own virtues; through selective breeding, the finest steeds under heaven emerge from this place.
Heroes of peerless horsemanship are granted their own courtyard estate, where they may refine their martial arts and train their steeds.
Those who achieve great merit may be granted the title of Marquis, each with their own fief and chancellor, ever fearless when battle calls.
Those who master dragon-riding become the Vast Dragon's chosen sons, leading armies to war across the land, mortal flesh wielding techniques fit to slay immortals.
